cards.title: Greenhouse Gear Garden Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: cross out one extra detail that does not belong
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional greenhouse gear garden story draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out this card, a pencil, and one broad made-up greenhouse gear garden draft before the writer checks it: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: check the pretend draft for a clear character, setting, sequence, useful details, clear sentences, and one next-draft pencil note: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: name the invented helper and the clear garden gear job that starts the draft: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: list two made-up greenhouse details, such as a gear shelf or crank table, that help the reader picture the place: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: write the first, next, and last draft moments so the gear garden action follows in order: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one useful greenhouse gear detail and cross out one extra detail that does not belong in this draft: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: choose one sentence and make sure the reader can tell who is turning, fixing, or carrying something: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: write one pencil note for the next fictional draft after checking character, setting, sequence, details, and sentences: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to one extra detail, and the writer decides whether to cross it out or keep it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: check another pretend garden draft for one useful detail and one detail to leave out: ____________________.

cards.title: Cloudberry Clocktower Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: add one clear feeling word without overexplaining
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional cloudberry clocktower story draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place a blank composition page beside the card and choose one invented clocktower draft for a calm paper check: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: read the pretend draft, then check character, setting, sequence, details, sentences, and one next-draft pencil note: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: name the made-up clock keeper and add one clear feeling word about the clocktower choice without explaining too much: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: write two clocktower details that help the draft feel specific but still invented: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: mark the first clock clue, the next shelf choice, and the final paper decision in order: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one useful cloudberry card or clock detail that helps the draft, and leave out one extra side detail: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: find one sentence where the feeling word fits the action and keeps the sentence clear: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: write one pencil note for the next fictional draft about the feeling word, sequence, or useful detail: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult reads one sentence aloud, and the writer adds only one simple feeling word on paper: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: check another pretend clocktower draft for one feeling word that helps the reader understand the character: ____________________.

cards.title: Moss Message Observatory Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: check that every sentence helps the story move
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional moss message observatory story draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: choose one broad invented moss message observatory draft and keep the check focused on paper marks only: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: check whether each sentence helps the pretend story move from character to setting to sequence to the next-draft note: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: underline the invented watcher and the clear message job that gives the draft a reason to move: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: list two made-up observatory details, such as a moss chart or pebble lens, that help the story action: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: number the message arrival, the observatory check, and the final choice so the order is easy to follow: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one detail that moves the moss message story forward and mark one detail that slows the draft down: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: read each sentence and put a small check beside the ones that help the story move: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: write one pencil note for the next fictional draft about a sentence to keep, shorten, or move: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult chooses two sentences, and the writer marks which one moves the story better: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: check another pretend observatory draft by asking whether every sentence helps the next story moment: ____________________.

cards.title: Orchard Pulley Post Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: find one sentence that needs a clearer subject
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional orchard pulley post story draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set the card beside one invented orchard pulley post draft and ask the writer to check one sentence at a time: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: check character, setting, sequence, useful details, and clear sentences, then add one next-draft pencil note: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: name the pretend pulley helper and make sure the reader knows who is raising or lowering the basket: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: write two invented orchard pulley post details that belong in the draft and help the reader see the place: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: mark the first pulley choice, the next basket movement, and the final post note in order: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one useful rope, basket, or post detail and cross out one detail that does not help this draft: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: find one sentence that starts with an unclear subject and rewrite it so the reader knows who or what acts: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: write one pencil note for the next fictional draft about the clearest subject or the sentence to fix first: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to one sentence, and the writer writes only the missing who or what: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: check another pretend pulley draft for one sentence that needs a clearer subject: ____________________.

cards.title: Pond Bridge Blueprint Club Draft Checklist Card
cards.draftChecklistSkill: replace one vague word with a story-specific word
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable composition notebook draft checklist card for checking one fictional pond bridge blueprint club story draft on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: choose one broad invented pond bridge blueprint club draft and keep the checklist work on printed paper and pencil: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: check the pretend draft for character, setting, sequence, useful details, clearer sentences, and one next-draft pencil note: ____________________.
cards.characterCheckPrompt: Character check: name the made-up bridge planner and the clear blueprint job that guides the draft: ____________________.
cards.settingCheckPrompt: Setting check: list two invented pond bridge blueprint details, such as a plank sketch or pebble marker, that help the reader picture the place: ____________________.
cards.sequenceCheckPrompt: Sequence check: write the first plan choice, the next bridge check, and the final club note in story order: ____________________.
cards.detailCheckPrompt: Detail check: circle one useful blueprint detail and choose one vague word, such as thing or stuff, to replace with a story-specific word: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCheckPrompt: Sentence check: rewrite one sentence so the specific pond, bridge, or blueprint word makes the action clearer: ____________________.
cards.finalDraftChecklistPrompt: Final draft checklist: write one pencil note for the next fictional draft naming the vague word to replace first: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult writes two possible story-specific words, and the writer circles the one that fits the draft: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: check another pretend blueprint draft for one vague word that can become a clearer story word: ____________________.
